description: The Institute of Electronics and Computer Science and Mondot SIA publish the Annotated Virtual Detection Line benchmark for road-traffic observation. It contains 74,108 NumPy data arrays with matching manual labels for vehicles, trucks, pedestrians, bicycles, motorcycles and scooters. Fifty cameras captured real road scenes under differing weather conditions, and Zenodo supplies separate data and label archives under CC BY 4.0. Free reuse can support training of counting systems that produce traffic-demand inputs or validation observations for road simulations. Exact geographic coverage is not specified in the short repository metadata, so global denotes transferable methods, not globally representative measurements. Classification and labelling errors were not assessed. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Dataset of Annotated Virtual Detection Line for Road Traffic Monitoring
